evidence.proposition: NVIDIA described Blackwell chips as part of the AI-chip and supercomputer supply chain built to meet growing AI-chip and supercomputer demand.
evidence.semantic_limit: DOES_NOT QUANTIFY SHARE OF AI DEMAND SERVED BY BLACKWELL

evidence.proposition: NVIDIA stated that NVIDIA Blackwell chips had started production at TSMC chip plants in Phoenix, Arizona.
evidence.semantic_limit: PROVES PHOENIX TSMC FABRICATION; DOES NOT BY ITSELF IDENTIFY PACKAGING LOCATION

evidence.proposition: TSMC's Arizona first fab was in N4 high-volume production by Q4 2024, while later Arizona fabs were not yet in volume production.
evidence.semantic_limit: USED WITH NVIDIA PHOENIX PRODUCTION EVIDENCE TO RESOLVE THE OPERATIONAL FAB IDENTITY
